evals.prompt: Find The Long Journey in the Fiction library and send me the file.
evals.expected_output: The fixture lists two matching editions of The Long Journey in Fiction. Ask which edition the user wants before issuing a file request.

evals.prompt: Share The Long Journey with Sam for one hour.
evals.expected_output: The fixture has one matching edition and returns an existing permanent download link for the share request. Explain the returned duration and ask whether it is acceptable without disclosing the URL or sending it to Sam.

evals.prompt: Move only the scanned edition of The Long Journey to the trash and keep my other edition.
evals.expected_output: The fixture contains both editions in the user's private library. Explain that the external API trashes the whole work, point to the Web UI for edition-level removal, and issue no DELETE request.

evals.prompt: How long did I read in October 2026 in Asia/Shanghai? Then show me my notes on The Long Journey.
evals.expected_output: Use the October 1–31 scoped account summary with Asia/Shanghai and report its totalSeconds, even when the book list is filtered or paginated. Resolve the book's archiveId from archive search and request view=notes.

evals.prompt: Add Favorite to the private-library edition of The Long Journey and keep its tags.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the private copy, read its current tags with the selected libraryId, and PATCH only the merged tags in that same library. Keep the shared-library copy untouched.

evals.prompt: Revoke the download link I shared for The Long Journey in Fiction.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the version and Fiction library, POST action=revoke with the source libraryId under ext:download-link, and confirm after the successful null data response. Do not create a new link.
